profile.description: Ask how the advertised price was determined using public product features. Do not ask for proprietary cost, margins, or private policy.
profile.name: Public Price Explanation

turns.buyer_visible_text: I'm interested in the Winter Jacket, but the advertised price of $180 is above my target range. To help me understand the value, could you clarify how the $180 price was determined based on publicly available product features — for example, insulation type (e.g., down vs. synthetic), fill power or gram weight, waterproof/breathable rating (e.g., mm H₂O / g/m²/24h), shell fabric denier or treatment, or any third-party performance certifications? That way I can assess whether the price reflects those tangible attributes. In the meantime, I can offer ### BUYER_PRICE($120) ### for the jacket.
